notes: Performance-only benchmark on the FULL test split (both staged halves), batched fp16 pipeline for max T4 utilization: latency percentiles, throughput, detections/frame, confidence stats. NO accuracy metrics — the test split has no public ground truth. Writes benchmarks.json to the kernel output AND publishes a marker-delimited section to the Hub model card (needs the external-secrets HF_TOKEN with write access; skipped with a warning otherwise).

slug=null -> the kaggle service runner derives the kernel name: <model>-<type> for index, <model>-<type>-<name> otherwise. Kernels live in a Kaggle collection named after the model (maintained in the UI — the API has no collections endpoint).
kernel_sources mounts BOTH staging kernels' OUTPUTS (sportsmot-test-1.tar + -2.tar, mutually exclusive halves of the full test split); the launcher refuses to push while that kernel is not COMPLETE.
Run the sibling testing/smoketest first — a few minutes validating this exact environment.
